objective: Make the next step clearer for a visitor evaluating recurring content support.

sources.excerpt: Our studio creates recurring social content for service businesses. Contact us to learn more. Every engagement starts with an agreed brief.
Tell us about your project. Share your name, email and a message.

findings.title: Give the service page one concrete next step
findings.observation: The supplied excerpt uses a broad contact invitation rather than naming the information needed to scope an engagement.
findings.impact_hypothesis: A specific brief request may make it easier for a visitor to start a useful conversation. Conversion impact has not been measured.
findings.recommended_action: Test: Send us your audience, theme and intended publication date, and we will confirm whether the scope fits.
findings.counter_evidence: The full page may already contain another more specific CTA. Review the whole page before adopting the change.

findings.title: Help visitors prepare a useful project message
findings.evidence_quote: Share your name, email and a message.
findings.observation: The supplied form excerpt requests a general message but does not specify audience, desired formats or timing.
findings.impact_hypothesis: Optional briefing prompts may reduce clarification work. The effect on form completion and buyer quality remains unknown.
findings.recommended_action: Add optional audience, deliverable-format and timing prompts; measure whether completed inquiries become easier to scope.
findings.counter_evidence: Additional fields may reduce completion. Keep prompts optional and compare actual inquiry quality.

limitations: All source content and this company are fictional. No live company was audited.
No analytics, conversion rates, advertising spend or buyer intent was observed.
This is a production specimen, not a paid engagement or a promise of business results.
